title: Strategy's $228M buyback beat its bitcoin buy, Bitmine adds ETH, Lighter drained
caption:
deal flow 🏦 strategy bought 485 btc (~$33.4m) last week but spent $228.1m buying back strc preferred shares, now holds 850,849 btc. bitmine added 7,653 eth to 6.08m eth, ~4.97% of supply. perp dex lighter paused withdrawals after ~$10.4m was drained via one trader's leaked api key. would you give an api key withdrawal rights? 👇 not financial advice.
